limitations: The lower-density statement is for origin-centred square annuli of fixed positive relative thickness. The set and constant may depend on the chosen thickness ratio; translated windows and arbitrarily thin relative annuli are not controlled. Constants depend on the implicit universal constant in the source bad-quadruple estimates and are not optimized. The motivating preprint is extremely recent, so unindexed parallel work remains possible.
record_title: Uniform thick-annulus density for extensible no-four-on-a-circle sets
